text: Why is the force margin only 0.068-0.103 in this 4-layer, d_model=64, N=64, 600-step setup, when it reached 0.22-0.24 in earlier runs? Is the difference driven by steps_per_orbit, model size, or training length? A one-factor sweep of steps_per_orbit (64 vs 1000) at fixed architecture would separate these.
